name: Noda Maruko
source:
A student at St. Celine's Academy, she is Kaede's crony. She is always with Kaede and makes her happy.

She is the one who has been feeding Kaede incorrect knowledge. She has the ability to appear out of nowhere.

She has an older brother at Seifu Academy near St. Celine School.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=203881&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
